notes: Modified cash basis school district; every fund is governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund column, no proprietary statement), so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements from the p4 Total Governmental Fund column (statement spans p3-4). Transfers 302,500 in and out net to nil in the total column (Reclassification column). 'Local receipts' split using General Fund p6 and School Nutrition p11 lines. State and federal programs counted as instruction. Detail: General Fund spending from the operational-expense schedule (pp14-19), which supersedes the function-only General Fund budget lines on p7; lines with zero actual are omitted. Transfers hidden inside support-services lines (25,000 staff p15, 100,000 maintenance p17, 70,000 bus p17) plus 70,000 to School Nutrition and 37,500 to Activities (p19) are recorded as other financing (negative, 302,500 total, matching p3 transfers); the printed GF total 4,567,867.72 includes them, while the statement GF column (p3) excludes them. Receiving sides: Depreciation 195,000 (p8), Nutrition 70,000 (p11), Activities 37,500 (p10). Activities Fund detail is from the account-by-account schedule p20 (receipts 162,160.74, disbursements 185,018.44; Hilltop gym row read 2,685.00 / 2,600.00 so columns tie to the printed totals), which supersedes the one-line budget schedule p10 except the 37,500 transfer. Page 21 is the prior-year (FY2024) activities schedule and was not used. Special Building and QCPU funds had no spending. Read pages 1-21 of 21
